name: ERA5 1991–2020 monthly climatology of 2 m temperature (30–70N), sea-level pressure and eastward surface stress (10S–10N) on 1°

source.dataset: ERA5, C3S/ECMWF, via NCAR RDA ds633.1: monthly means of daily means (e5.moda.an.sfc, e5.moda.fc.sfc.meanflux)
source.citation: ERA5 Reanalysis (Monthly Mean 0.25 Degree Latitude-Longitude Grid), ECMWF, NSF NCAR 2019
references: Hersbach et al. 2020, Q. J. R. Meteorol. Soc. 146, 1999–2049
source.license: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), ECMWF's license for Copernicus data since 2 July 2025, which replaced the Copernicus license
source.changes: a 1991-2020 monthly climatology from a 1° subsample

period: 1991-01 to 2020-12, each calendar month the mean of 30 years
box: per field: south to north, all longitudes
mask: lsm (ERA5's land-sea mask, January 2000) is the last field: a box row takes the model's own land or sea cells and samples each at its center bilinearly, the four points' weights multiplied by lsm on a land cell and by 1 − lsm on a sea cell and renormalized (plain bilinear where they sum to zero), then averages the cells by area (scripts/references.mjs, sampleEra5)
definition: float32 little-endian, fields in this order, each [month][row][column], rows from `south` northward at 1°, columns from 0°E at 1°. Matching model quantities, all from the run's day means: t2m the model's air temperature at 2 m above its surface, not the skin and not the lowest layer (about 20 m up): the model keeps no 2 m diagnostic yet (one is being added with the surface layer), so until it lands a 40–60N land row compares its lowest layer's air at that layer's own height and is not definition-matched; msl its mean sea-level pressure; metss its eastward turbulent stress on the surface (the run's exchange, not a rebuilt one).
